title: Grilled Teriyaki Tofu
blurb: Firm tofu marinated in a sweet soy glaze, then grilled until golden with a sticky coating.
steps: Press the tofu between clean tea towels with a weight on top for 15 minutes to remove excess water, then slice into eight rectangular pieces about 1cm thick.
Peel and grate the ginger and garlic into a shallow dish, then whisk in the tamari, honey, rice vinegar and sesame oil.
Add the tofu slices to the marinade, turning to coat all sides, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, turning once halfway through.
Heat a griddle pan over medium-high heat and spray lightly with olive oil.
Remove the tofu from the marinade, reserving the liquid, and grill for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until charred lines appear.
Pour the reserved marinade into a small pan and simmer for 2 minutes until slightly thickened, then brush over the grilled tofu before serving.
